title: fix(plugin-grid): head a date / datetime group the way its cell draws the key
body:
Fixes #13234

Clause-②: no

## What changed

A grid grouped by a `date` or `datetime` field headed its groups with the stored string (`2026-10-01`) while the cell of a row under them read "Oct 1". The group-heading formatter, `groupValueFormatter` in `ObjectGrid.tsx`, resolves select / multi-select keys from `options` and booleans to Yes / No; every other type returned `undefined`, so the band drew the raw key.

The band now draws a `date` / `datetime` key the way the cell under it draws the same value:

- **Which fields.** Per grouping field, the new `temporalGroupFaces` memo reads the declared type `groupValueFormatter` reads (the authored column's `type` over the object field's) and takes it through the cells' one shared resolve, `resolveGridCellRendering`. A heading is drawn as a date exactly when the cell under it is a `date` or `datetime` cell.
- **How.** The new `temporalGroupHeading` calls the date cells' own formatters with the cells' own arguments: `formatDate(value, format || 'relative', ...)` for a `date` (as `DateCellRenderer` does); for a `datetime`, `formatRelativeDate` for `'relative'`, the compact face for no format and for `'short'`, and `formatDateTime` with the authored word otherwise (as `DateTimeCellRenderer` does). The locale is `useDisplayLocale()`, the channel both cells read. No date is formatted in the grid itself.
- **Datetime granularity.** A `datetime` group stays the stored instant (the server's `GROUP BY` granularity, the client's exact-value bucket), and its heading draws that instant. No day bucketing: that would change the groups and their counts.
- **Empty and unparsable keys.** An empty key keeps its "(empty)" heading; a key the cells cannot parse keeps its stored text.
- **Deadlines.** A heading names a day, not one row's deadline. `dueLike`'s "Overdue Nd" wording and red are a per-row verdict (`settledWhen` is judged per row), so a `dueLike` field's heading reads the face's neutral phrase ("3 days ago").

### Why at the band, not in `groupValueFormatter`

The grouping hook (`useGroupedDataInOptionOrder`) ORDERS groups by the label that formatter returns, and a stored day sorts in calendar order only as the stored string. Measured with a one-off experiment (reverted; restore proven, blob equal to HEAD and `git diff HEAD` empty): a `date` arm added to `groupValueFormatter` drew the same headings and reordered the groups. With `order: 'desc'` the keys came back `2026-09-01`, `2026-10-01`, `2026-08-01` ... (the formatted labels' alphabetical order), and 5 of the 25 new pins went red, every one an order pin. So each group keeps the stored key as its label (its sort key) and only the text drawn in its band changes. Order and counts are untouched, and `useGroupedData.ts` is not edited.

### The one restated part

The face SELECTION (`format || 'relative'` for a date; none or `'short'` to compact and `'relative'` to relative for a datetime) lives inside the two cell renderers and is not exported from `@object-ui/fields`, so `temporalGroupHeading` restates it. It is pinned, not trusted: the new suite compares every heading with the cell under it in the same grid, for every face (`date`: none, `relative`, `short`, `YYYY-MM-DD`; `datetime`: none, `relative`, `short`, `compact`, `YYYY-MM-DD`), so a move on either side turns it red. A shared cell-text function exported from `@object-ui/fields` would remove the restatement, but it adds an export in a second package (`Clause-②` would read yes), so it is not done here.

## Tests

New: `packages/plugin-grid/src/__tests__/groupDateHeading-13234.test.tsx`, 25 tests, server-grouped and client-grouped:

- each `date` / `datetime` heading equals the cell under it, for every face above, and is never the stored key;
- CONTROL: descending and ascending order are the stored keys' order, the counts are unchanged, and the empty group keeps "(empty)";
- CONTROL: a text key reads as itself;
- a two-level grouping with the date first (the reported view's shape) heads its first level as the cell reads.

Readings, every run through the shared verify lock:

- **Before the fix** (`878a4af38` plus the new test file): `Tests 19 failed | 6 passed (25)`, for example `expected '2026-10-17' to be '3 days ago'` and `expected '2026-10-18T12:22:52.797Z' to be '10/18/2026 12:22 pm'`. The 6 that passed are the controls.
- **Ablation** at HEAD `73db59d4e` (fix committed; the band reverted to `label={group.label}` with `ablation-replace.mjs`, mutation proven on disk, anchor 1 to 0, blob changed; restore proven, blob equal to HEAD and `git diff HEAD` empty): `Tests 19 failed | 6 passed (25)`, the same 19.
- **After**, at HEAD `73db59d4e`: the 30 plugin-grid test files that name `groupValueFormatter` or `grouping`, plus the new one: `Test Files 31 passed (31)`, `Tests 297 passed (297)`. The select and boolean heading suites are among them, unchanged and green.

## Gates (local, HEAD `73db59d4e`, exit codes captured before any pipe)

- `pnpm --filter @object-ui/plugin-grid lint`: exit 0 (0 errors; no warning on a changed line or in the new file).
- `pnpm --filter @object-ui/plugin-grid type-check` (`tsc --noEmit` and `tsc -p tsconfig.test.json`): exit 0, after building the dependency closure (`turbo run build --filter='@object-ui/plugin-grid^...'`, 13 of 13). `--listFiles` shows the test project compiles the new test file.
- `pnpm check:new-line-citations`: exit 0, 0 new citations.
- `pnpm check:control-bytes`: exit 0.
- `node scripts/check-changeset-presence.mjs`: exit 0, one changeset declared.
- `node scripts/check-changeset-no-major.mjs`: exit 0.

The full `pnpm test` and the repository-level lint are CI's.

Changeset: `.changeset/13234-group-date-heading.md`, `@object-ui/plugin-grid` patch. No export, prop, type member or language-pack key moves.

## Acceptance notes

- **Bound, not filed.** A grouping field with NO declared type, whose cell infers a date face from the field's name (the columns' `inferColumnType` heuristic), keeps its stored-string heading: the heading reads the declared type only, as the boolean arm of `groupValueFormatter` does. No producer was measured. Carrier: none.
- **The restated face selection** (above). Carrier: none.
- Relative headings move with the clock exactly as the cells do ("3 days ago" today, a date once the key is more than seven days away).
